verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server (probe-4), so an AI agent can drive Stripe operations from natural-language prompts. An llms.txt (probe-1) makes the docs consumable by LLMs. Natural-language operation therefore depends on an external agent/MCP client rather than a native interface, and nothing confirms the MCP tools cover Connect-specific actions. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product or Dashboard, evidence that the MCP server covers Connect operations (onboarding, payouts, connected accounts), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
